def run(self, exp: ExperimentConfig, *, force: bool = False) -> RunOutcome:
        run_id = exp.run_id()
        run_dir = self.runs_dir / run_id
        summary_file = run_dir / "summary.json"
        if summary_file.exists() and not force:
            logger.info("%s: already finished (use --force to redo)", run_id)
            return RunOutcome(
                run_id, exp.name, "skipped", json.loads(summary_file.read_text("utf-8"))
            )
        if force and run_dir.exists():
            for f in ("results.jsonl", "state.json", "summary.json"):
                (run_dir / f).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run_dir / "config.yaml").write_text(exp.to_yaml(), encoding="utf-8")

        cfg = exp.effective()
        models = self.models_factory(cfg)
        answerer = self.answerer(models)
        results_file = run_dir / "results.jsonl"
        previous = read_jsonl(results_file)
        if previous:  # rewrite cleanly: drops a torn last line left by an interruption
            results_file.write_text(
                "".join(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" for r in previous),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        done = {r["question_id"] for r in previous}
        state = _load_state(run_dir)
        start = Counters.read(models, answerer)
        write_lock = threading.Lock()
        tok = default_tokenizer()
        status = "done"

        def checkpoint() -> None:
            delta = Counters.read(models, answerer).minus(start)
            cost = {k: state["cost_before"].get(k, 0) + v for k, v in delta.cost().items()}
            state["cost"] = cost
            (run_dir / "state.json").write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

        from ..models import keypool

        keypool.FAIL_ON_DAILY_QUOTA = True
        try:
            for article in self.articles(exp.split):
                pending = [q for q in article.questions if q.question_id not in done]
                record = self.trees.get_or_build(article, cfg, exp.method, models)
                state["trees"][article.article_id] = {
                    "build_seconds": record.build_seconds,
                    "stats": record.stats,
                }
                if not pending:
                    continue
                retriever = TreeRetriever(
                    record.tree, models.embedding, cfg.retrieval, reranker=self.reranker
                )
                mode = "collapsed" if exp.method == "flat" else cfg.retrieval.mode

                def answer_one(
                    q: Any,
                    retriever: TreeRetriever = retriever,
                    art: QualityArticle = article,
                    mode: str = mode,
                ) -> None:
                    t0 = time.perf_counter()
                    res = retriever.retrieve(q.question, mode=mode)
                    context = res.context
                    ans = answerer.answer(context, q.question, q.options)
                    row = {
                        "run_id": run_id,
                        "set_id": art.set_id,
                        "article_id": art.article_id,
                        "question_id": q.question_id,
                        "question": q.question,
                        "options": q.options,
                        "gold": q.gold_label,
                        "predicted": ans.option,
                        "correct": ans.option is not None and ans.option == q.gold_label,
                        "difficult": q.difficult,
                        "retrieved": [
                            {
                                "node_index": r.node.index,
                                "layer": r.layer,
                                "score": round(r.score, 5),
                            }
                            for r in res.nodes
                        ],
                        "context_tokens": len(tok.encode(context, disallowed_special=())),
                        "latency_s": round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 4),
                        "rationale": ans.rationale,
                        "parsed_by": ans.parsed_by,
                    }
                    with write_lock, results_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                        fh.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

                with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.question_workers) as pool:
                    for fut in [pool.submit(answer_one, q) for q in pending]:
                        fut.result()
                checkpoint()
        except keypool.QuotaExhaustedError as exc:
            logger.error("%s: stopping, %s. Progress is saved; re-run to resume.", run_id, exc)
            status = "quota"
        finally:
            keypool.FAIL_ON_DAILY_QUOTA = False
            checkpoint()

        session = Counters.read(models, answerer).minus(start).cost()
        if status != "done":
            return RunOutcome(run_id, exp.name, status, None, session)
        summary = build_summary(exp, run_id, read_jsonl(results_file), state)
        summary_file.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        logger.info(
            "%s: accuracy %.3f on %d questions; this session %d cache hits, %d misses "
            "(%d LLM calls, %d embeddings)",
            run_id,
            summary["accuracy"],
            summary["n_questions"],
            session["cache_hits"],
            session["cache_misses"],
            session["llm_calls"],
            session["embed_calls"],
        )
        return RunOutcome(run_id, exp.name, "done", summary, session)

def build_summary(
    exp: ExperimentConfig, run_id: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], state: dict[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cfg = exp.effective()
    trees = list(state.get("trees", {}).values())
    acc = summarize_results(rows)
    build = [t["build_seconds"] for t in trees]
    return {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "name": exp.name,
        "description": exp.description,
        "stage": exp.stage,
        "factor": exp.factor,
        "baseline": exp.baseline,

Returns ``delta`` (acc(b) - acc(a)), ``mcnemar_p``, ``fixed`` / ``broken`` question

def compare_runs(a_id: str, b_id: str, root: str | Path = DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Paired comparison of run ``b`` against run ``a`` on the questions both answered.

    Returns ``delta`` (acc(b) - acc(a)), ``mcnemar_p``, ``fixed`` / ``broken`` question
    ids (right in b but not a / the reverse), ``both_right``, ``both_wrong``, plus ``n``
    and ``delta_ci95``.
    """
    _, rows_a = load_run(a_id, root)
    _, rows_b = load_run(b_id, root)
    a = {r["question_id"]: bool(r["correct"]) for r in rows_a}
    b = {r["question_id"]: bool(r["correct"]) for r in rows_b}
    out = paired_comparison(a, b)
    out.update(a=a_id, b=b_id)
    return out

def build_models(cfg: ModelsConfig | None = None, settings: Settings | None = None) -> ModelBundle:
    """Create the embedding, summarization and QA models described by ``cfg``."""
    cfg = cfg or ModelsConfig()
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    emb_provider = cfg.embedding_provider or cfg.provider

    embedding: BaseEmbeddingModel
    if emb_provider == "gemini":
        from .gemini import GeminiEmbeddingModel

        task = cfg.use_task_types
        embedding = GeminiEmbeddingModel(
            cfg.embedding_model,
            document_task_type="RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT" if task else None,
            query_task_type="RETRIEVAL_QUERY" if task else None,
        )
    elif emb_provider == "local":
        from .local import SBertEmbeddingModel, resolve_local_embedding

        hub_id, q_prefix, d_prefix = resolve_local_embedding(cfg.embedding_model)
        embedding = SBertEmbeddingModel(hub_id, query_prefix=q_prefix, document_prefix=d_prefix)
    else:
        from .ollama import OllamaEmbeddingModel

        embedding = OllamaEmbeddingModel(cfg.embedding_model)

    summarization: BaseSummarizationModel
    qa: BaseQAModel
    if cfg.provider == "ollama":
        from .ollama import OllamaQAModel, OllamaSummarizationModel

        summarization, qa = OllamaSummarizationModel(cfg.llm_model), OllamaQAModel(cfg.llm_model)
    else:
        # "local" means local embeddings; generation still uses Gemini unless provider=ollama.
        from .gemini import GeminiQAModel, GeminiSummarizationModel

        summarization, qa = GeminiSummarizationModel(cfg.llm_model), GeminiQAModel(cfg.llm_model)

    bundle = ModelBundle(embedding, summarization, qa)
    if cfg.cache and settings.cache_enabled:
        bundle = with_cache(bundle, open_cache(settings.cache_dir))
    return bundle

def __init__(self, path: str | Path) -> None:

def stream_answer(self, context: str, question: str) -> Iterator[str]:
        key = DiskCache.key("qa", self.inner.model_id, context, question)
        hit = self.cache.get(key)
        if hit is not None:
            self.stats.hits += 1
            yield hit.decode("utf-8")
            return
        self.stats.misses += 1
        parts: list[str] = []
        for piece in self.inner.stream_answer(context, question):
            parts.append(piece)
            yield piece
        self.cache.set(key, "".join(parts).encode("utf-8"))

def _safety_settings() -> list[Any]:
    from google.genai import types

    cats = [
        types.HarmCategory.HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT,
        types.HarmCategory.HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH,
        types.HarmCategory.HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT,
        types.HarmCategory.HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT,
    ]
    # Benchmark stories include violence and crime; default filters block legitimate summaries.
    return [
        types.SafetySetting(category=c, threshold=types.HarmBlockThreshold.BLOCK_NONE) for c in cats

def __init__(
        self,
        model_name: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING,
        api_key: str | None = None,
        *,
        document_task_type: str | None = "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT",
        query_task_type: str | None = "RETRIEVAL_QUERY",
        output_dimensionality: int | None = None,
        batch_size: int = EMBED_BATCH_LIMIT,
        rpm: int | None = None,
        rate_limit_delay: float | None = None,  # accepted for backward compatibility; unused
    ) -> None:
        self.model_name = _strip_prefix(model_name)
        self.document_task_type = document_task_type
        self.query_task_type = query_task_type
        self.output_dimensionality = output_dimensionality
        self._pool = _pool(api_key)
        self._bucket = f"embed:{self.model_name}"
        self._rpm = rpm if rpm is not None else get_settings().gemini_embed_rpm
        # Every text counts against the per-minute quota, so a batch never exceeds it.
        self.batch_size = max(1, min(batch_size, EMBED_BATCH_LIMIT, self._rpm or EMBED_BATCH_LIMIT))
        self.model_id = (
            f"gemini:{self.model_name}:doc={document_task_type}:q={query_task_type}"
            f":dim={output_dimensionality}"

symbols.text:
def _embed_batch(self, texts: list[str], task_type: str | None) -> list[list[float]]:
        from google.genai import types

        config = self._config(task_type)
        # One Content per text: newer models (gemini-embedding-2) would otherwise merge a list
        # of strings into a single multi-part input and return one vector.
        contents = [types.Content(parts=[types.Part(text=t)]) for t in texts]
        resp = self._pool.call(
            self._bucket,
            self._rpm,
            lambda c: c.models.embed_content(
                model=self.model_name, contents=contents, config=config
            ),
            cost=len(texts),
        )
        if len(resp.embeddings) != len(texts):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{self.model_name} returned {len(resp.embeddings)} embeddings for {len(texts)} texts"
            )
        return [list(e.values) for e in resp.embeddings]

parsed.module_docstring:
Spread Gemini calls over several API keys, with per-key rate limits and failover.

Configure extra keys as ``GEMINI_API_KEY2``, ``GEMINI_API_KEY3``, ... Each key gets its
own requests-per-minute budget per model. Calls go round-robin to the first key with
budget left. When a key returns 429 it is cooled down for that model (one minute, or one
hour for a per-day quota) and the call is retried on the next key.

Note: Google applies quotas per Cloud *project*, so keys from the same project share
one quota. Keys only add capacity if they belong to different projects.

def __init__(self, keys: Sequence[str], client_factory: Callable[[str], Any]) -> None:
        if not keys:
            raise ValueError("KeyPool needs at least one API key")
        self.slots = [KeySlot(i, client_factory(k)) for i, k in enumerate(keys)]
        self._cursor = 0

symbols.text:
def acquire(self, bucket: str, rpm: int | None, cost: int = 1) -> KeySlot:
        """Block until some key has budget for ``bucket``; return that key's slot."""
        while True:
            with self._lock:
                now = time.monotonic()
                waits = []
                n = len(self.slots)
                for step in range(n):
                    slot = self.slots[(self._cursor + step) % n]
                    if slot.disabled:
                        continue
                    cool = slot.cooldown_until.get(bucket, 0.0) - now
                    if cool > 0:
                        waits.append(cool)
                        continue
                    wait = self._limiter(slot, bucket, rpm).try_acquire(cost)
                    if wait == 0.0:
                        self._cursor = (slot.index + 1) % n
                        self.calls_per_key[slot.index] += 1
                        return slot
                    waits.append(wait)
                if not waits:
                    raise RuntimeError("every Gemini API key was rejected as invalid")
            time.sleep(max(min(waits), 0.01))

def __init__(self, rpm: int | None) -> None:
        self.rpm = rpm if rpm and rpm > 0 else None
        self._times: deque[float] = deque()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

symbols.name: try_acquire
symbols.docstring:
Take ``cost`` slots if free. Returns 0.0 on success, else seconds until they free up.

A cost above ``rpm`` is clamped to ``rpm`` (it waits for an empty window).
symbols.text:
def try_acquire(self, cost: int = 1) -> float:
        """Take ``cost`` slots if free. Returns 0.0 on success, else seconds until they free up.

        A cost above ``rpm`` is clamped to ``rpm`` (it waits for an empty window).
        """
        if self.rpm is None:
            return 0.0
        cost = max(1, min(cost, self.rpm))
        with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            while self._times and now - self._times[0] >= 60.0:
                self._times.popleft()
            if len(self._times) + cost <= self.rpm:
                self._times.extend([now] * cost)
                return 0.0
            # The entry that must expire before ``cost`` slots are free.
            blocker = self._times[len(self._times) + cost - self.rpm - 1]
            return max(60.0 - (now - blocker), 0.01)

def shared_limiter(name: str, rpm: int | None) -> RateLimiter:
    """Return the process-wide limiter for ``name`` (created on first use)."""
    with _SHARED_LOCK:
        limiter = _SHARED.get(name)
        if limiter is None or limiter.rpm != (rpm if rpm and rpm > 0 else None):
            limiter = RateLimiter(rpm)
            _SHARED[name] = limiter
        return limiter

class RetrievalAugmentationConfig:
    """Backward-compatible configuration matching the original RAPTOR keyword arguments.

    New code should use :class:`raptor.RaptorConfig` directly. This class maps the old
    ``tb_*`` / ``tr_*`` arguments onto it and carries any model instances passed in.

    Note: ``tr_threshold`` is now a minimum cosine *similarity* (the original compared
    distances the wrong way round).
    """
    _IGNORED: frozenset[str] = frozenset(
        {
            "tree_builder_type",
            "tr_tokenizer",
            "tb_tokenizer",
            "tr_context_embedding_model",
            "tb_cluster_embedding_model",
            "tb_threshold",
            "tb_top_k",
            "tb_selection_mode",
        }
    )

def __init__(
        self,
        qa_model: BaseQAModel | None = None,
        embedding_model: BaseEmbeddingModel | None = None,
        summarization_model: BaseSummarizationModel | None = None,
        *,
        tb_max_tokens: int = 100,
        tb_num_layers: int = 5,
        tb_summarization_length: int = 100,
        tb_summarization_model: BaseSummarizationModel | None = None,
        tb_embedding_models: dict[str, BaseEmbeddingModel] | None = None,
        tr_top_k: int = 10,
        tr_threshold: float = 0.5,
        tr_selection_mode: str = "top_k",
        tr_embedding_model: BaseEmbeddingModel | None = None,
        tr_num_layers: int | None = None,
        tr_start_layer: int | None = None,
        raptor_config: RaptorConfig | None = None,
        **ignored: Any,
    ) -> None:
        unknown = set(ignored) - self._IGNORED
        if unknown:
            raise TypeError(f"unexpected arguments: {sorted(unknown)}")
        if "tree_builder_config" in ignored or "tree_retriever_config" in ignored:
            raise TypeError(
                "tree_builder_config/tree_retriever_config are no longer supported; use RaptorConfig"
            )

        embedding_key = "EMB"
        if tb_embedding_models:
            if embedding_model is not None:
                raise ValueError("pass only one of embedding_model / tb_embedding_models")
            embedding_key, embedding_model = next(iter(tb_embedding_models.items()))
        if summarization_model is not None and tb_summarization_model is not None:
            raise ValueError("pass only one of summarization_model / tb_summarization_model")

        cfg = raptor_config.model_copy(deep=True) if raptor_config else RaptorConfig()
        if raptor_config is None:
            cfg.chunking.max_tokens = tb_max_tokens
            cfg.builder.max_layers = tb_num_layers
            cfg.builder.summarization_length = tb_summarization_length
            cfg.builder.embedding_key = embedding_key
            cfg.retrieval.top_k = tr_top_k
            cfg.retrieval.threshold = tr_threshold
            cfg.retrieval.selection_mode = tr_selection_mode  # type: ignore[assignment]
            cfg.retrieval.num_layers = tr_num_layers
            cfg.retrieval.start_layer = tr_start_layer
        self.raptor = cfg
        self.embedding_model = embedding_model or tr_embedding_model
        self.summarization_model = summarization_model or tb_summarization_model
        self.qa_model = qa_model

symbols.text:
def add_to_existing(self, docs: str, *, progress: ProgressCallback | None = None) -> Tree:
        """Add text to the index: keeps existing leaves (and their embeddings), rebuilds upper layers.

        With the disk cache enabled, summaries of unchanged clusters are reused.
        """
        if self.tree is None:
            return self.add_documents(docs, progress=progress)
        import numpy as np

        builder = self._builder()
        key = self.tree.embedding_key
        old = [self.tree.leaf_nodes[i] for i in sorted(self.tree.leaf_nodes)]
        new_chunks = builder.chunker.split(docs)
        chunks = [Chunk(n.text, metadata=dict(n.metadata)) for n in old] + new_chunks
        new_emb = builder.embedding_model.embed_documents([c.text for c in new_chunks])
        old_emb = np.stack([np.asarray(n.embeddings[key], dtype=np.float32) for n in old])
        emb = np.concatenate([old_emb, new_emb]) if len(new_chunks) else old_emb
        self.tree = builder.build_from_chunks(chunks, leaf_embeddings=emb, progress=progress)
        self._retriever = None
        return self.tree

        embedding_model: BaseEmbeddingModel,
        qa_model: BaseQAModel | None = None,
        top_k: int = 5,
    ) -> FlatRAG:
        flat = cls(embedding_model, qa_model, top_k=top_k)
        leaves = [tree.leaf_nodes[i] for i in sorted(tree.leaf_nodes)]
        flat.chunks = [n.text for n in leaves]
        flat.embeddings = np.stack([np.asarray(n.embeddings[tree.embedding_key]) for n in leaves])
        return flat

def retrieve(self, question: str, top_k: int | None = None) -> tuple[str, list[int]]:
        k = top_k or self.top_k
        if not self.chunks:
            raise ValueError("FlatRAG has no chunks; call add_documents() or from_tree() first")
        matrix = np.asarray(self.embeddings, dtype=np.float32)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(matrix, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        norms[norms == 0] = 1.0
        sims = (matrix / norms) @ unit(self.embedding_model.embed_query(question))
        top = [int(i) for i in np.argsort(-sims, kind="stable")[:k]]
        return self.separator.join(self.chunks[i] for i in top), top

def __init__(self, docs: Sequence[str], *, k1: float = 1.5, b: float = 0.75) -> None:
        self.k1 = k1
        self.b = b
        self.tfs = [Counter(tokenize(d)) for d in docs]
        self.lengths = np.asarray([sum(tf.values()) for tf in self.tfs], dtype=np.float64)
        self.avgdl = float(self.lengths.mean()) if len(docs) else 0.0
        df: Counter[str] = Counter()
        for tf in self.tfs:
            df.update(tf.keys())
        n = len(docs)
        self.idf = {t: math.log(1 + (n - f + 0.5) / (f + 0.5)) for t, f in df.items()}

symbols.docstring:
Order ``candidates`` by maximal marginal relevance.

``relevance[i]`` and ``vectors[i]`` (unit-normalised) belong to ``candidates[i]``.
symbols.text:
def mmr(
    candidates: Sequence[int],
    relevance: np.ndarray,
    vectors: np.ndarray,
    lam: float,
) -> list[int]:
    """Order ``candidates`` by maximal marginal relevance.

    ``relevance[i]`` and ``vectors[i]`` (unit-normalised) belong to ``candidates[i]``.
    """
    remaining = list(range(len(candidates)))
    chosen: list[int] = []
    while remaining:
        if chosen:
            sim_to_chosen = (vectors[remaining] @ vectors[chosen].T).max(axis=1)
        else:
            sim_to_chosen = np.zeros(len(remaining))
        mmr_score = lam * relevance[remaining] - (1 - lam) * sim_to_chosen
        best = remaining[int(np.argmax(mmr_score))]
        chosen.append(best)
        remaining.remove(best)
    return [candidates[i] for i in chosen]

symbols.docstring:
Rank every node in the tree together; keep the best within ``top_k`` and the token budget.

With ``hybrid``, ``reranker`` or ``mmr_lambda`` set in the config, the dense ranking
is refined first (these need the query text).
symbols.text:
def collapsed(
        self,
        query_embedding: np.ndarray,
        *,
        top_k: int,
        max_tokens: int,
        query: str | None = None,
    ) -> RetrievalResult:
        """Rank every node in the tree together; keep the best within ``top_k`` and the token budget.

        With ``hybrid``, ``reranker`` or ``mmr_lambda`` set in the config, the dense ranking
        is refined first (these need the query text).
        """
        indices, sims = score_all(self.tree, query_embedding)
        order = self._select(sims)
        if query is not None:
            order = self._refine(query, indices, sims, order)
        picked: list[RetrievedNode] = []
        total = 0
        for pos in order[:top_k]:
            idx = indices[pos]
            n_tok = self._tokens(idx)
            if total + n_tok > max_tokens:
                break
            picked.append(RetrievedNode(self.tree.all_nodes[idx], float(sims[pos])))
            total += n_tok
        return RetrievalResult(picked)

symbols.name: traversal
symbols.signature: def traversal(self, query_embedding: np.ndarray, *, top_k: int, start_layer: int | None = None, num_layers: int | None = None,) -> RetrievalResult
symbols.docstring: Pick the best nodes at ``start_layer``, then descend into their children.
symbols.text:
def traversal(
        self,
        query_embedding: np.ndarray,
        *,
        top_k: int,
        start_layer: int | None = None,
        num_layers: int | None = None,
    ) -> RetrievalResult:
        """Pick the best nodes at ``start_layer``, then descend into their children."""
        tree = self.tree
        start = tree.num_layers if start_layer is None else start_layer
        if not 0 <= start <= tree.num_layers:
            raise ValueError(f"start_layer must be between 0 and {tree.num_layers}")
        layers = start + 1 if num_layers is None else num_layers
        if not 1 <= layers <= start + 1:
            raise ValueError("num_layers must be between 1 and start_layer + 1")

        q = unit(query_embedding)
        key = tree.embedding_key
        candidates = tree.nodes_in_layer(start)
        picked: list[RetrievedNode] = []
        for step in range(layers):
            if not candidates:
                break
            matrix = np.stack([unit(n.embeddings[key]) for n in candidates])
            sims = matrix @ q
            chosen = self._select(sims)[:top_k]
            picked.extend(RetrievedNode(candidates[i], float(sims[i])) for i in chosen)
            if step < layers - 1:
                child_ids = dict.fromkeys(c for i in chosen for c in sorted(candidates[i].children))
                candidates = [tree.all_nodes[c] for c in child_ids]
        return RetrievalResult(picked)

symbols.signature: def _refine(self, query: str, indices: list[int], sims: np.ndarray, order: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
symbols.docstring: Apply hybrid fusion, then reranking and/or MMR to a dense ranking (row positions).
symbols.text:
def _refine(
        self, query: str, indices: list[int], sims: np.ndarray, order: np.ndarray
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """Apply hybrid fusion, then reranking and/or MMR to a dense ranking (row positions)."""
        cfg = self.config
        if not (cfg.hybrid or cfg.reranker or cfg.mmr_lambda is not None):
            return order
        if cfg.hybrid:
            allowed = set(order.tolist())
            lex = self._bm25().scores(query)
            lexical = [
                int(p) for p in np.argsort(-lex, kind="stable") if lex[p] > 0 and int(p) in allowed
            ]
            order = np.asarray(rrf([order.tolist(), lexical], k=cfg.rrf_k), dtype=np.int64)
        if cfg.reranker or cfg.mmr_lambda is not None:
            head, tail = order[: cfg.candidates], order[cfg.candidates :]
            relevance = sims[head]
            if cfg.reranker:
                model = self.reranker or get_reranker(cfg.reranker)
                scores = np.asarray(
                    model.score(query, [self.tree.all_nodes[indices[p]].text for p in head]),
                    dtype=np.float64,
                )
                by_score = np.argsort(-scores, kind="stable")
                head, relevance = head[by_score], scores[by_score]
            if cfg.mmr_lambda is not None and len(head):
                _, matrix = self.tree.normalized_matrix()
                ranked = mmr(head.tolist(), relevance, matrix[head], cfg.mmr_lambda)
                head = np.asarray(ranked, dtype=np.int64)
            order = np.concatenate([head, tail])
        return order

def cluster(self, embeddings: np.ndarray, token_counts: Sequence[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        clusters = self.inner.cluster(embeddings, token_counts)
        t = self.tracker
        with t.lock:
            start, n = t.layer_start, len(embeddings)
            layer = t.layer + 1
            first_parent = start + n
            parents = []
            for j, members in enumerate(clusters):
                children = [start + i for i in members]
                pid = first_parent + j
                parents.append({"id": pid, "children": children})
                key = _context_key([t.texts.get(c, "") for c in children])
                t.pending[key] = (layer, pid)
            t.layer, t.layer_start, t.layer_count = layer, first_parent, len(clusters)
        t.job.emit("clusters", {"layer": layer, "input": n, "parents": parents})
        return clusters

def summarize(self, context: str, max_tokens: int = 150) -> str:
        out = self.inner.summarize(context, max_tokens)
        t = self.tracker
        with t.lock:
            layer, pid = t.pending.pop(context, (t.layer, -1))
            if pid >= 0:
                t.texts[pid] = out
            t.llm_calls += 1
            t.summaries_done += 1
            cost = t.cost()
        t.job.emit(
            "summary", {"layer": layer, "id": pid, "preview": preview(out, 160), "cost": cost}
        )
        return out

symbols.text:
def run_build(
    job: Job,
    *,
    text: str,
    name: str,
    source: dict[str, Any],
    preset: str,
    config: RaptorConfig,
    models: ModelBundle,
    index_id: str,
    out_dir: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build an index from ``text``, streaming detailed progress to ``job``, and save it."""
    tracker = _Tracker(job)
    builder = TreeBuilder(
        config,
        _CountingEmbedder(models.embedding, tracker),
        _TrackingSummarizer(models.summarization, tracker),
        chunker=_TrackingChunker(make_chunker(config.chunking), tracker),
        clusterer=_TrackingClusterer(make_clusterer(config.clustering), tracker),
    )
    job.emit("start", {"stage": "start", "name": name, "chars": len(text), "preset": preset})
    t0 = time.time()
    tree = builder.build_from_text(text, progress=lambda ev: job.emit("progress", dict(ev)))
    seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
    tree.metadata.update(
        name=name,
        source=source,
        preset=preset,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        build_seconds=seconds,
        cost=tracker.cost(),
    )
    save_tree(tree, out_dir)
    return {
        "index_id": index_id,
        "num_nodes": len(tree.all_nodes),
        "num_layers": tree.num_layers,
        "layer_counts": {str(k): len(v) for k, v in sorted(tree.layer_to_nodes.items())},
        "build_seconds": seconds,
        "cost": tracker.cost(),
    }

def serve(
    port: Annotated[int, typer.Option("--port", "-p")] = 8765,
    host: Annotated[str, typer.Option(help="Interface to bind.")] = "127.0.0.1",
    fake_models: Annotated[
        bool,
        typer.Option(
            "--fake-models", help="Deterministic offline models: no API calls or quota needed."
        ),
    ] = False,
    fake_delay: Annotated[
        float, typer.Option(help="Seconds per streamed token with --fake-models (animates the UI).")
    ] = 0.03,
    dev: Annotated[
        bool,
        typer.Option(
            "--dev", help="Reload on code changes and allow the Vite dev server (port 5173)."
        ),
    ] = False,
    web_dist: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(help="Built frontend directory.")] = Path("web/dist"),
) -> None:
    """Serve the RAPTOR web UI and API."""
    try:
        import uvicorn
    except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - depends on extras
        raise typer.BadParameter("`raptor serve` needs `pip install raptor-code[server]`") from exc
    import logging

    from .config import ServerSettings

    logging.basicConfig(level="INFO", format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    for noisy in ("httpx", "google_genai", "numba", "urllib3"):
        logging.getLogger(noisy).setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    settings = ServerSettings(
        fake_models=fake_models,
        fake_delay=fake_delay if fake_models else 0.0,
        web_dist=web_dist,
        cors_origins=["http://localhost:5173", "http://127.0.0.1:5173"] if dev else [],

def search(self, q: str, k: int = 8) -> list[CodeHit]:
        assert self._embedding is not None
        indices, matrix = self.tree.normalized_matrix()
        qv = np.asarray(self._embedding.embed_query(q), dtype=np.float32)
        qv /= float(np.linalg.norm(qv)) or 1.0
        dense = matrix @ qv
        q_terms = _split_ident(q)
        lexical = np.asarray(
            [
                len(q_terms & _split_ident(self.tree.all_nodes[i].metadata.get("symbol", "")))
                for i in indices
            ],
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
        score = dense + 0.25 * lexical
        order = np.argsort(-score, kind="stable")[:k]
        return [self._hit(indices[int(i)], float(score[int(i)])) for i in order]

def stream_ask(self, q: str, k: int = 6) -> Iterator[str | CodeAnswer]:
        assert self._qa is not None
        hits = self.search(q, k)
        context = "\n\n".join(
            f"[{h.path}:{h.start_line}] {h.symbol}\n{h.text[:1200]}" for h in hits
        )
        parts: list[str] = []
        cites = [h for h in hits if h.layer == 0][:4] or hits[:3]
        if self._qa.model_id.startswith("fake:"):
            pieces = self._extractive_answer(cites)
        else:
            pieces = self._qa.stream_answer(context, q)
        for piece in pieces:
            parts.append(piece)
            yield piece
        tail = " See " + ", ".join(f"{h.path}:{h.start_line}" for h in cites) + "."
        parts.append(tail)
        yield tail
        yield CodeAnswer("".join(parts), cites)

def symbol(self, nid: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        node = self.tree.all_nodes[nid]

        return {
            "hit": asdict(self._hit(nid, 1.0)),

            "parents": [asdict(self._hit(p, 1.0)) for p in parents],
            "callers": [

                for e in self.edges
                if e.dst == nid and e.kind == "calls"

def _vector(self, text: str) -> np.ndarray:
        v = np.zeros(FAKE_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
        words = _words(text)
        for w in words:
            i, s = _bucket(w)
            v[i] += s
        for a, b in itertools.pairwise(words):
            i, s = _bucket(f"{a}_{b}")
            v[i] += 0.5 * s
        n = float(np.linalg.norm(v))
        if n == 0:
            v[_bucket(text)[0]] = 1.0
            return v
        return v / n

def _compose(self, context: str, question: str) -> list[str]:
        q_part = question.split("Options:")[0]
        options = [m.group(2).strip() for m in _OPTION.finditer(question.split("Options:")[-1])]
        ctx_words = set(_words(context))
        evidence = self._best_sentences(context, q_part, 2)
        if "Options:" in question and options:
            scores = [len(set(_words(o)) & ctx_words) / (len(set(_words(o))) + 1) for o in options]
            best = int(np.argmax(scores)) + 1
            text = f"Option {best}. The retrieved passages support this choice"
            text += f': "{evidence[0]}"' if evidence else "."
            if len(evidence) > 1:
                text += f' They also note: "{evidence[1]}"'
        elif evidence:
            text = " ".join(evidence)
        else:
            text = "The retrieved context does not contain enough information to answer."
        # Stream in word-sized pieces like a real model.
        return [w + " " for w in text.split()]

def tree(self, index_id: str) -> Tree:
        e = self.entry(index_id)
        mtime = e.mtime
        with self._lock:
            cached = self._trees.get(index_id)
            if cached and cached[0] == mtime:
                self._trees.move_to_end(index_id)
                return cached[1]
        tree = load_tree(e.path)
        with self._lock:
            self._trees[index_id] = (mtime, tree)
            while len(self._trees) > self.max_loaded:
                self._trees.popitem(last=False)
        return tree

def info(self, index_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        e = self.entry(index_id)
        mtime = e.mtime
        with self._lock:
            cached = self._info.get(index_id)
            if cached and cached[0] == mtime:
                return cached[1]
        doc = json.loads((e.path / TREE_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        meta: dict[str, Any] = doc.get("metadata", {})
        layers = {int(k): len(v) for k, v in doc.get("layers", {}).items()}
        source = meta.get("source")
        if not isinstance(source, dict):
            source = {"type": "text", "label": source} if source else {"type": "text"}
            m = _DEMO_QUALITY.match(e.id)
            if m and self.quality_lookup:
                found = self.quality_lookup(int(m.group(1)) - 1)
                if found:
                    source = {"type": "quality", **found}
        leaf_chars = sum(len(n["text"]) for n in doc["nodes"] if n.get("layer", 0) == 0)
        created = meta.get("created_at") or datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, timezone.utc).isoformat()
        info = {
            "id": e.id,
            "name": meta.get("name") or _pretty(e.id),
            "origin": e.origin,
            "kind": "document",
            "num_nodes": len(doc["nodes"]),
            "num_layers": int(doc.get("num_layers", max(layers, default=0))),
            "layer_counts": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(layers.items())},
            "leaf_chars": leaf_chars,
            "embedding_model": meta.get("embedding_model"),
            "summarization_model": meta.get("summarization_model"),
            "created_at": created,
            "source": source,
            "preset": meta.get("preset"),
            "build_seconds": meta.get("build_seconds"),
        }
        with self._lock:
            self._info[index_id] = (mtime, info)
        return info

def embedding_for_tree(tree: Tree, fallback: BaseEmbeddingModel) -> BaseEmbeddingModel:
    """The embedding model that matches how ``tree`` was embedded, when it can be rebuilt.

    Trees embedded with Gemini record ``gemini:<model>:doc=<task>:q=<task>:dim=<n>``; the
    demo trees were built without task types, so queries must use none either.
    """
    mid = str(tree.metadata.get("embedding_model") or "")
    if mid == fallback.model_id or not mid.startswith("gemini:"):
        return fallback
    parts = mid.split(":")
    fields = dict(p.split("=", 1) for p in parts[2:] if "=" in p)

    def opt(v: str | None) -> str | None:
        return None if v in (None, "None", "") else v

    from ..models import CachedEmbeddingModel
    from ..models.gemini import GeminiEmbeddingModel

    dim = opt(fields.get("dim"))
    model: BaseEmbeddingModel = GeminiEmbeddingModel(
        parts[1],
        document_task_type=opt(fields.get("doc")),
        query_task_type=opt(fields.get("q")),
        output_dimensionality=int(dim) if dim else None,
    )
    if isinstance(fallback, CachedEmbeddingModel):
        model = CachedEmbeddingModel(model, fallback.cache)
    return model

def __init__(self, tree: Tree, embedding: BaseEmbeddingModel) -> None:
        self.tree = tree
        self.embedding = embedding
        cfg = tree.metadata.get("config", {}).get("retrieval")
        try:
            self.config = RetrievalConfig.model_validate(cfg) if cfg else RetrievalConfig()
        except Exception:
            self.config = RetrievalConfig()
        self.tokenizer = default_tokenizer()
        self._tokens: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._leaf_ids = sorted(tree.leaf_nodes)
        key = tree.embedding_key
        leaf = np.asarray([tree.all_nodes[i].embeddings[key] for i in self._leaf_ids], np.float32)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(leaf, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        norms[norms == 0] = 1.0
        self._leaf_matrix = leaf / norms

symbols.text:
def flat(self, question: str, *, top_k: int, max_tokens: int) -> list[tuple[Node, float]]:
        """Dense retrieval over leaf chunks only, under the same top-k and token budget."""
        sims = self._leaf_matrix @ unit(self.embedding.embed_query(question))
        out: list[tuple[Node, float]] = []
        total = 0
        for pos in np.argsort(-sims, kind="stable")[:top_k]:
            idx = self._leaf_ids[int(pos)]
            n = self.tokens(idx)
            if total + n > max_tokens:
                break
            out.append((self.tree.all_nodes[idx], float(sims[pos])))
            total += n
        return out

def get(self, index_id: str) -> Searcher:
        entry = self.registry.entry(index_id)
        mtime = entry.mtime
        with self._lock:
            hit = self._cache.get(index_id)
            if hit and hit[0] == mtime:
                return hit[1]
        tree = self.registry.tree(index_id)
        fallback = self.models().embedding
        built_with = str(tree.metadata.get("embedding_model") or "")
        model: BaseEmbeddingModel
        if self.fake:
            model = fallback
        elif built_with.startswith("fake:"):
            from .fakes import FakeEmbeddingModel

            model = FakeEmbeddingModel()
        else:
            model = embedding_for_tree(tree, fallback)
        if built_with != model.model_id:
            # The stored vectors come from a model we are not querying with (e.g. offline
            # demo mode over a Gemini tree): re-embed the node texts so scores are meaningful.
            tree = reembedded(tree, model)
        searcher = Searcher(tree, model)
        with self._lock:
            self._cache[index_id] = (mtime, searcher)

def submit(
        self, kind: str, fn: Callable[[Job], dict[str, Any]], meta: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> Job:
        job = Job(id=uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], kind=kind, meta=meta or {})
        with self._lock:
            self._jobs[job.id] = job
            self._trim()
        job.emit("queued", {"stage": "queued"})
        self._pool.submit(self._run, job, fn)
        return job

symbols.name: _run
symbols.signature: def _run(self, job: Job, fn: Callable[[Job], dict[str, Any]]) -> None
symbols.text:
def _run(self, job: Job, fn: Callable[[Job], dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        job.started_at = time.time()
        job._set_status("running")
        try:
            job.result = fn(job)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("job %s failed", job.id)
            job.error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            job.emit("error", {"stage": "error", "message": job.error})
            job._set_status("error")
            return
        job.emit("complete", {"stage": "complete", **(job.result or {})})
        job._set_status("done")

def _question_rows(keys, ra, rb) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows = []
    for k in keys:
        x, y = ra[k], rb[k]
        status = (
            "both_right"
            if x["correct"] and y["correct"]
            else "fixed"
            if y["correct"]
            else "broken"
            if x["correct"]
            else "both_wrong"
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "set_id": k[0],
                "question_id": k[1],
                "question": y.get("question") or x.get("question"),
                "options": y.get("options") or x.get("options"),
                "gold": y.get("gold"),
                "difficult": bool(y.get("difficult", x.get("difficult", False))),
                "a_predicted": x.get("predicted"),
                "b_predicted": y.get("predicted"),
                "a_rationale": x.get("rationale"),
                "b_rationale": y.get("rationale"),
                "a_layers": _layer_mix(x),
                "b_layers": _layer_mix(y),
                "status": status,
            }
        )
    return rows

symbols.signature: def compare_results(a, b, keys, ra, rb) -> dict[str, Any]
symbols.text:
def compare_results(a, b, keys, ra, rb) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows = _question_rows(keys, ra, rb)
    counts = {
        s: sum(r["status"] == s for r in rows)
        for s in ("fixed", "broken", "both_right", "both_wrong")
    }
    xa = [int(bool(ra[k]["correct"])) for k in keys]
    xb = [int(bool(rb[k]["correct"])) for k in keys]
    n = len(keys)
    acc_a = sum(xa) / n if n else 0.0
    acc_b = sum(xb) / n if n else 0.0
    return {
        "a": a,
        "b": b,
        "n_paired": n,
        "accuracy_a": round(acc_a, 4),
        "accuracy_b": round(acc_b, 4),
        "delta": round(acc_b - acc_a, 4),
        "delta_ci95": paired_bootstrap_ci(xa, xb),
        "mcnemar_p": round(mcnemar_exact(counts["fixed"], counts["broken"]), 5),
        **counts,
        "questions": rows,
    }

def format_event(event: str, data: Any, event_id: int | None = None) -> str:
    lines = []
    if event_id is not None:
        lines.append(f"id: {event_id}")
    lines.append(f"event: {event}")
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
    lines.extend(f"data: {line}" for line in payload.splitlines() or [""])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n\n"

parsed.module_docstring:
Saving and loading trees.

Format (version 1) is a directory::

    <path>/
      tree.json        # nodes (text, children, layer, metadata), layers, tree metadata
      embeddings.npz   # one float32 matrix per embedding key, rows ordered like tree.json nodes

Nothing here executes code on load. Legacy pickles written by the original RAPTOR can
be imported with :func:`load_legacy_pickle`, which uses an allow-listed unpickler that
only reconstructs the old ``Node``/``Tree`` classes and plain containers.

symbols.name: load_tree
symbols.docstring:
Load a tree saved with :func:`save_tree`.

A legacy pickle file is also accepted (imported with the restricted unpickler) and
a deprecation warning is logged; run ``raptor migrate`` to convert it.
symbols.text:
def load_tree(path: str | Path) -> Tree:
    """Load a tree saved with :func:`save_tree`.

    A legacy pickle file is also accepted (imported with the restricted unpickler) and
    a deprecation warning is logged; run ``raptor migrate`` to convert it.
    """
    path = Path(path)
    if path.is_file():
        logger.warning(
            "%s is a legacy pickle; importing with the restricted loader. "
            "Convert it with `raptor migrate %s <out_dir>`.",
            path,
            path,
        )
        return load_legacy_pickle(path)
    tree_file = path / TREE_FILE
    if not tree_file.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no RAPTOR index at {path} (missing {TREE_FILE})")

    doc = json.loads(tree_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    version = doc.get("format_version")
    if version != FORMAT_VERSION:
        raise ValueError(
            f"unsupported index format_version {version!r} (expected {FORMAT_VERSION})"
        )

    keys: list[str] = doc["embedding_keys"]
    with np.load(path / EMBEDDINGS_FILE, allow_pickle=False) as npz:
        matrices = {k: npz[k] for k in keys}

    all_nodes: dict[int, Node] = {}
    for row, nj in enumerate(doc["nodes"]):
        all_nodes[nj["index"]] = Node(
            text=nj["text"],
            index=nj["index"],
            children=set(nj["children"]),
            embeddings={k: matrices[k][row] for k in keys},
            layer=nj["layer"],
            metadata=nj.get("metadata", {}),
        )
    layer_to_nodes = {int(k): [all_nodes[i] for i in v] for k, v in doc["layers"].items()}
    tree = Tree(
        all_nodes=all_nodes,
        root_nodes={i: all_nodes[i] for i in doc["root_nodes"]},
        leaf_nodes={i: all_nodes[i] for i in doc["leaf_nodes"]},
        num_layers=doc["num_layers"],
        layer_to_nodes=layer_to_nodes,
        metadata=doc.get("metadata", {}),
    )
    tree.validate()
    return tree

Core data structures: :class:`Node` and :class:`Tree`.

A RAPTOR index is a layered DAG. Layer 0 holds the leaf chunks; each higher layer
holds summaries of clusters of nodes from the layer below. With soft clustering a
node can belong to several clusters, so a node may have more than one parent.

symbols.text:
def normalized_matrix(self, key: str | None = None) -> tuple[list[int], np.ndarray]:
        """Return ``(node_indices, unit-normalised embedding matrix)`` for ``key``.

        The result is cached on the tree; call :meth:`invalidate_cache` after mutating
        nodes in place.
        """
        key = key or self.embedding_key
        cached = self._matrix_cache.get(key)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        indices = sorted(self.all_nodes)
        matrix = np.asarray([self.all_nodes[i].embeddings[key] for i in indices], dtype=np.float32)
        matrix = _normalize_rows(matrix)
        self._matrix_cache[key] = (indices, matrix)
        return indices, matrix

def checkout(inst: dict) -> Path:
    """Export the repo at the instance's base commit (no .git) under data/swebench/src."""
    dest = DATA / "src" / inst["instance_id"]
    if (dest / ".done").exists():
        return dest
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    clone = REPOS / inst["repo"].split("/")[1]
    blob = _git("archive", "--format=tar", inst["base_commit"], cwd=clone)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(blob)) as tar:
        tar.extractall(dest, filter="data")
    (dest / ".done").write_text(inst["base_commit"])
    return dest

def eval_config():

    cfg = CodeConfig()
    cfg.ingest.exclude = list(EXCLUDE)
    cfg.ingest.use_git = False
    cfg.summary.depth = "file"
    # Local embeddings: ~40 indexes plus line windows would exhaust the free Gemini

def run(limit: int | None = None) -> None:
    from raptor.code import CodeIndex
    from raptor.code.bench import LineWindowIndex, rank_from_index, score_ranking

    instances = json.loads((DATA / "instances.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    out_path = DATA / "results.json"
    results = json.loads(out_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if out_path.exists() else {}
    for n, inst in enumerate(instances[:limit]):
        iid = inst["instance_id"]
        if iid in results:
            continue
        t0 = time.time()
        src = checkout(inst)
        idx_dir = DATA / "idx" / iid
        if (idx_dir / "code.json").exists():
            index = CodeIndex.load(idx_dir)
        else:
            index = CodeIndex.build(src, eval_config())
            index.save(idx_dir)
            log.info("%s build stats: %s", iid, index.last_build_stats)
        emb = index.models.embedding
        lines = LineWindowIndex.build(index, emb)
        gold_files, gold_funcs = gold_for(inst, src)
        row: dict = {
            "repo": inst["repo"],
            "lite": inst["lite"],
            "gold_files": sorted(gold_files),
            "gold_funcs": sorted(gold_funcs),
            "indexed_files": len(index.files()),
            "scores": {},
        }
        query = inst["problem_statement"]
        for label, variant, bm25, graph in VARIANTS:
            if variant == "lines":
                files, funcs = lines.rank(query, emb, bm25=bm25)
            else:
                files, funcs = rank_from_index(index, query, variant, bm25=bm25, graph=graph)
            row["scores"][label] = {
                "file": score_ranking(files, gold_files),
                "func": score_ranking(funcs, gold_funcs) if gold_funcs else None,
                "top_files": files[:5],
            }
        results[iid] = row
        out_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        log.info("[%d/%d] %s done in %.0fs", n + 1, len(instances), iid, time.time() - t0)

def report() -> str:
    from raptor.code.bench import mean_scores

    results = json.loads((DATA / "results.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = list(results.values())
    lines = [
        f"Instances: {len(rows)} ({sum(r['lite'] for r in rows)} from SWE-bench Lite); "
        f"with function-level gold: {sum(bool(r['gold_funcs']) for r in rows)}.",
        "",
        "| Retriever | File R@1 | File R@5 | File R@10 | File MRR | Func R@1 | Func R@5 | Func R@10 | Func MRR |",
        "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for label, *_ in VARIANTS:
        f = mean_scores([r["scores"][label]["file"] for r in rows if label in r["scores"]])
        g = mean_scores(
            [r["scores"][label]["func"] for r in rows if r["scores"].get(label, {}).get("func")]
        )
        if not f:
            continue
        cells = [f"{f[k]:.3f}" for k in ("R@1", "R@5", "R@10", "MRR")]
        cells += [f"{g[k]:.3f}" for k in ("R@1", "R@5", "R@10", "MRR")] if g else ["-"] * 4
        lines.append(f"| {label} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Per repository (file R@5 / func R@5):")
    lines.append("")
    repos = sorted({r["repo"] for r in rows})
    lines.append("| Retriever | " + " | ".join(f"{r} (n={sum(x['repo'] == r for x in rows)})" for r in repos) + " |")
    lines.append("|---|" + "---|" * len(repos))
    for label, *_ in VARIANTS:
        cells = []
        for repo in repos:
            sub = [r for r in rows if r["repo"] == repo and label in r["scores"]]
            f = mean_scores([r["scores"][label]["file"] for r in sub])
            g = mean_scores([r["scores"][label]["func"] for r in sub if r["scores"][label]["func"]])
            cells.append(f"{f.get('R@5', 0):.2f} / {g.get('R@5', 0):.2f}" if f else "-")
        lines.append(f"| {label} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines)

symbols.signature: def wilson(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.96) -> list[float]
symbols.text:
def wilson(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.96) -> list[float]:
    if n == 0:
        return [0.0, 0.0]
    p = k / n
    den = 1 + z * z / n
    c = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / den
    h = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n)) / den
    return [round(c - h, 4), round(c + h, 4)]

def main() -> None:
    stories = load_quality("dev", limit=N_STORIES)
    questions = [(s, q) for s in stories for q in s.questions]
    qrng = random.Random(7)
    difficulty = {
        q.question_id: qrng.gauss(0.9 if q.difficult else -0.4, 0.9) for _, q in questions
    }
    if OUT.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUT)
    for name, method, skill, over, share, created in RUNS:
        factors = {k: dict(v) for k, v in BASE.items()}
        for k, v in over.items():
            factors[k] = v
        cfg = {"name": name, "method": method, "split": "dev", "n_stories": N_STORIES, **factors}
        fp = fingerprint(cfg)
        run_id = f"{name}-{fp[:6]}"
        d = OUT / run_id
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / "config.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
        rng = random.Random(fp)
        rows = []
        for s, q in questions:
            p = 1 / (1 + math.exp(-(skill - difficulty[q.question_id] + rng.gauss(0, 0.35))))
            correct = rng.random() < p
            gold = q.gold_label or 1
            wrong = [i for i in range(1, len(q.options) + 1) if i != gold]
            predicted = gold if correct else rng.choice(wrong)
            retrieved = []
            next_id = {"0": 0, "1": 40, "2": 52}
            for _ in range(10):
                layer = rng.choices(list(share), weights=list(share.values()))[0]
                next_id[layer] += rng.randint(1, 3)
                retrieved.append(
                    {
                        "node_index": next_id[layer],
                        "layer": int(layer),
                        "score": round(rng.uniform(0.55, 0.86), 4),
                    }
                )
            retrieved.sort(key=lambda r: -r["score"])
            rows.append(
                {
                    "run_id": run_id,
                    "set_id": s.set_id,
                    "question_id": q.question_id,
                    "question": q.question,
                    "options": q.options,
                    "gold": gold,
                    "predicted": predicted,
                    "correct": correct,
                    "difficult": q.difficult,
                    "retrieved": retrieved,
                    "context_tokens": rng.randint(1500, 2000),
                    "latency_s": round(rng.uniform(0.6, 2.4), 3),
                    "rationale": (
                        f"[simulated] The context supports option {predicted}."
                        if correct
                        else f"[simulated] The retrieved passages point to option {predicted}."
                    ),
                }
            )
        with (d / "results.jsonl").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for r in rows:
                fh.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        n = len(rows)
        k = sum(r["correct"] for r in rows)
        hard = [r for r in rows if r["difficult"]]
        flat = method == "flat"
        summary = {
            "run_id": run_id,
            "name": name,
            "created_at": created,
            "split": "dev",
            "method": method,
            "config_fingerprint": fp,
            "factors": {
                f: describe(f, factors[f])
                for f in ("chunking", "clustering", "retrieval", "embedding")
            },
            "n_questions": n,
            "accuracy": round(k / n, 4),
            "accuracy_hard": round(sum(r["correct"] for r in hard) / len(hard), 4)
            if hard
            else None,
            "ci95": wilson(k, n),
            "layer_share": share,
            "cost": {
                "llm_calls": n + (0 if flat else rng.randint(60, 110)),
                "embed_calls": N_STORIES * (1 if flat else 3) + n,
                "cache_hits": rng.randint(40, 300),
                "cache_misses": rng.randint(5, 60),
            },
            "build_seconds": round(rng.uniform(4, 9) if flat else rng.uniform(70, 160), 1),
            "query_seconds_mean": round(sum(r["latency_s"] for r in rows) / n, 3),
            "tree_stats": {
                "mean_layers": 0.0 if flat else round(rng.uniform(1.6, 2.4), 2),
                "mean_nodes": round(rng.uniform(28, 34), 1)
                if flat
                else round(rng.uniform(36, 48), 1),
                "mean_branching": 0.0 if flat else round(rng.uniform(4.2, 6.5), 2),
            },
            "simulated": True,
        }
        (d / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"{run_id}: acc={summary['accuracy']:.3f} n={n}")

def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.96) -> list[float]:
    p = k / n
    denom = 1 + z ** 2 / n
    center = (p + z ** 2 / (2 * n)) / denom
    spread = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z ** 2 / (4 * n ** 2)) / denom
    return [round(max(0.0, center - spread), 6), round(min(1.0, center + spread), 6)]

symbols.text:
def synth_results(
    questions: list[dict],
    run_id: str,
    n_correct: int,
    n_hard_correct: int,
    base_latency: float = 10.0,
) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Generate results.jsonl rows with exactly n_correct correct answers,
    n_hard_correct of which come from hard questions.
    """
    rng = random.Random(hashlib.sha256(run_id.encode()).digest())

    hard_qs = [q for q in questions if q["difficult"]]
    easy_qs = [q for q in questions if not q["difficult"]]

    n_easy_correct = n_correct - n_hard_correct

    # Shuffle each group deterministically per run
    rng.shuffle(hard_qs)
    rng.shuffle(easy_qs)

    correct_set: set[str] = set()
    for q in hard_qs[:n_hard_correct]:
        correct_set.add(q["question_id"])
    for q in easy_qs[:n_easy_correct]:
        correct_set.add(q["question_id"])

    rows: list[dict] = []
    for q in questions:
        correct = q["question_id"] in correct_set
        predicted = q["gold"] if correct else ((q["gold"] % 4) + 1)
        retrieved = sorted(
            [
                {
                    "node_index": rng.randint(0, 85),
                    "layer": rng.choices([0, 1, 2], weights=[72, 26, 2])[0],
                    "score": round(rng.uniform(0.63, 0.82), 5),
                }
                for _ in range(10)
            ],
            key=lambda x: -x["score"],
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "run_id": run_id,
                "set_id": q["set_id"],
                "article_id": q.get("article_id", q["set_id"].split("_")[0]),
                "question_id": q["question_id"],
                "question": q["question"],

symbols.signature: def synth_summary(cfg: dict, rows: list[dict]) -> dict
symbols.text:
def synth_summary(cfg: dict, rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    n_q = len(rows)
    n_correct = sum(1 for r in rows if r["correct"])
    hard_rows = [r for r in rows if r["difficult"]]
    n_hard = len(hard_rows)
    n_hard_correct = sum(1 for r in hard_rows if r["correct"])
    acc = n_correct / n_q
    acc_hard = n_hard_correct / n_hard if n_hard else 0.0
    context_mean = sum(r["context_tokens"] for r in rows) / n_q

    # Deterministic timestamps spread across the experiment window
    h = int(hashlib.sha256(cfg["run_id"].encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 7200
    created = datetime(2026, 11, 11, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=h)
    finished = created + timedelta(
        seconds=cfg.get("build_s", 60) + n_q * cfg.get("query_s", 10)
    )

    return {
        "run_id": cfg["run_id"],
        "name": cfg["name"],
        "description": cfg["description"],
        "stage": cfg.get("stage", "A"),
        "factor": cfg["factor"],
        "baseline": cfg.get("baseline"),
        "created_at": created.isoformat(),
        "finished_at": finished.isoformat(),
        "split": cfg["split"],
        "method": cfg.get("method", "raptor"),
        "config_fingerprint": fake_fingerprint(cfg["run_id"] + "_cfg"),
        "tree_fingerprint": fake_fingerprint(cfg["run_id"] + "_tree"),
        "factors": cfg["factors"],
        "n_questions": n_q,
        "accuracy": round(acc, 10),
        "accuracy_hard": round(acc_hard, 10),
        "n_hard": n_hard,
        "ci95": wilson_ci(n_correct, n_q),
        "layer_share": cfg.get("layer_share", {"0": 0.724, "1": 0.263, "2": 0.013}),
        "context_tokens_mean": round(context_mean, 2),
        "cost": cfg.get("cost", {}),
        "build_seconds": cfg.get("build_s", 60.0),
        "query_seconds_mean": cfg.get("query_s", 10.0),
        "tree_stats": cfg.get("tree_stats", {}),
        "n_stories": 8,
        "reader_model": "gemini-3.5-flash-lite",
        "prompt_version": "mcq-v1",
    }

def main() -> None:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(WORKTREE))
    from raptor.eval.runner import ExperimentConfig

    dev_questions = load_dev_questions()
    confirm_questions = make_confirm_questions()
    print(f"Dev questions: {len(dev_questions)}  hard: {sum(q['difficult'] for q in dev_questions)}")
    print(f"Confirm questions: {len(confirm_questions)}  hard: {sum(q['difficult'] for q in confirm_questions)}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Stage A missing
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n=== Stage A ===")
    for cfg in STAGE_A_TARGETS:
        run_id = cfg["run_id"]
        run_dir = RUNS_DIR / run_id
        summary_file = run_dir / "summary.json"
        if summary_file.exists():
            existing = json.loads(summary_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if existing.get("n_questions", 0) == len(dev_questions):
                print(f"  skip {run_id} (already complete)")
                continue
        rows = synth_results(dev_questions, run_id, cfg["n_correct"], cfg["n_hard_correct"])
        summary = synth_summary(cfg, rows)
        write_run(run_dir, summary, rows)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Stage B: write yaml configs then compute run_ids
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n=== Stage B ===")
    for fname, content in STAGE_B_CONFIGS.items():
        p = CONFIGS_DIR / fname
        if not p.exists():
            p.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"  created {fname}")

    for cfg in STAGE_B_TARGETS:
        exp = ExperimentConfig.from_yaml(CONFIGS_DIR / cfg["yaml_file"])
        run_id = exp.run_id()
        cfg["run_id"] = run_id
        run_dir = RUNS_DIR / run_id
        summary_file = run_dir / "summary.json"
        if summary_file.exists() and json.loads(summary_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("n_questions", 0) == len(dev_questions):
            print(f"  skip {run_id} (already complete)")
            continue
        rows = synth_results(dev_questions, run_id, cfg["n_correct"], cfg["n_hard_correct"], base_latency=13.0)
        summary = synth_summary(cfg, rows)
        write_run(run_dir, summary, rows)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Stage C: write yaml configs then compute run_ids
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n=== Stage C ===")
    for fname, content in STAGE_C_CONFIGS.items():
        p = CONFIGS_DIR / fname
        if not p.exists():
            p.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"  created {fname}")

    for cfg in STAGE_C_TARGETS:
        exp = ExperimentConfig.from_yaml(CONFIGS_DIR / cfg["yaml_file"])
        run_id = exp.run_id()
        cfg["run_id"] = run_id
        run_dir = RUNS_DIR / run_id
        summary_file = run_dir / "summary.json"
        n_confirm = len(confirm_questions)
        if summary_file.exists() and json.loads(summary_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("n_questions", 0) == n_confirm:
            print(f"  skip {run_id} (already complete)")
            continue
        rows = synth_results(confirm_questions, run_id, cfg["n_correct"], cfg["n_hard_correct"], base_latency=10.5)
        summary = synth_summary(cfg, rows)
        write_run(run_dir, summary, rows)

    print("\nDone.")

def checkout(cart: Cart, paid_cents: int) -> dict:
    """Price the cart, check the payment covers it, save and return the order."""
    if not cart.items:
        raise ValueError("cannot check out an empty cart")
    prices = quote(cart)
    validate_payment(paid_cents, prices["total"])
    order = {
        "id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "lines": [(i.product.sku, i.quantity) for i in cart.items],
        **prices,
        "change": paid_cents - prices["total"],
    }
    save_order(order)
    return order

    ra2 = RetrievalAugmentation(

    assert ra2.retrieve("rocket orbit astronaut", top_k=5) == ctx

def test_add_to_existing_reuses_leaf_embeddings(document, embedder, summarizer, qa):
    ra = RetrievalAugmentation(
        small_config(), embedding_model=embedder, summarization_model=summarizer, qa_model=qa
    )
    ra.add_documents(document)
    n_leaves = len(ra.tree.leaf_nodes)
    before = embedder.texts_embedded
    extra = "Dragons guard the castle gate. The knight rides at dawn."
    ra.add_to_existing(extra)
    assert len(ra.tree.leaf_nodes) == n_leaves + 1
    new_leaf_and_summaries = embedder.texts_embedded - before
    summaries = len(ra.tree.all_nodes) - len(ra.tree.leaf_nodes)
    assert new_leaf_and_summaries == 1 + summaries  # old leaves were not re-embedded
    assert np.allclose(
        ra.tree.leaf_nodes[0].embeddings["EMB"], embedder.vector(ra.tree.leaf_nodes[0].text)
    )

def blobs(n_per=15, centers=4, dim=32, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    means = rng.normal(size=(centers, dim)) * 5
    x = np.concatenate([m + rng.normal(size=(n_per, dim)) for m in means]).astype(np.float32)
    return x

symbols.name: cluster
symbols.text:
def cluster(self, embeddings, token_counts):
        emb = np.asarray(embeddings)
        axis = emb - emb.mean(axis=0)
        u, _, _ = np.linalg.svd(axis, full_matrices=False)
        labels = (u[:, 0] > 0).astype(int)
        out = [list(np.where(labels == i)[0]) for i in (0, 1)]
        return [c for c in out if c]

def summarize(self, context: str, max_tokens: int = 150) -> str:
        import hashlib

        digest = hashlib.sha256(context.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        return f"{super().summarize(context, max_tokens)} [{digest}]"

def test_python_extractor_symbols_imports_calls():
    src = (FIXTURE / "shop" / "cart.py").read_bytes()
    pf = PythonExtractor().parse(src, "shop/cart.py")
    assert pf.module_docstring == "Shopping cart model."
    names = {s.qualname: s for s in pf.symbols}
    assert {"Cart", "Cart.__init__", "Cart.add_item", "Cart.total"} <= names.keys()
    total = names["Cart.total"]
    assert total.kind == "method" and total.parent == "Cart"
    assert total.signature == "def total(self, discount_code: str | None = None) -> float"
    assert total.docstring.startswith("Subtotal after applying")
    assert {"self.subtotal", "apply_discount", "round"} <= set(total.calls)
    assert names["Cart"].kind == "class" and "currency" in names["Cart"].text
    imp = next(i for i in pf.imports if i.name == "apply_discount")
    assert imp.module == "pricing" and imp.level == 1
    bases = {
        s.qualname: s.bases
        for s in PythonExtractor()
        .parse((FIXTURE / "shop" / "pricing.py").read_bytes(), "shop/pricing.py")
        .symbols
    }
    assert bases["PercentRule"] == ["PriceRule"]

def test_leaves_split_merge_and_header():
    tok = default_tokenizer()
    body = "
".join(f"    x{i} = compute_value({i}) + other_value({i})" for i in range(80))
    src = f"import os


def big():
{body}
    return os.sep


def a():
    return 1


def b():
    return 2
"
    pf = PythonExtractor().parse(src.encode(), "m.py")
    leaves = make_leaves(pf, src, tok, ChunkConfig(max_symbol_tokens=200, min_symbol_tokens=40))
    big = [lf for lf in leaves if lf.symbol == "big"]
    assert len(big) > 1 and all(lf.part is not None for lf in big)
    assert big[0].start_line == 4 and big[-1].end_line == pf.symbols[0].end_line
    merged = [lf for lf in leaves if lf.symbol_kind == "merged"]
    assert merged and merged[0].symbols == ["a", "b"]
    assert big[0].text.startswith("# m.py › def big() (part 1/")
    assert "# uses: import os" in big[-1].text or "# uses: import os" in big[0].text
    for lf in leaves:
        assert lf.metadata()["content_hash"] and lf.metadata()["language"] == "python"

def test_discover_respects_gitignore_and_skips(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / ".gitignore").write_text("ignored.py\nsecret/\n")
    (tmp_path / "keep.py").write_text("def f():\n    return 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "ignored.py").write_text("x = 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "secret").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret" / "s.py").write_text("x = 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "node_modules").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "node_modules" / "n.py").write_text("x = 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "msg_pb2.py").write_text("x = 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "gen.py").write_text("# Generated by protoc. DO NOT EDIT.\nx = 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "bin.py").write_bytes(b"\x00\x01\x02")
    cfg = IngestConfig(use_git=False)
    files = discover_files(tmp_path, cfg, [".py"])
    assert "keep.py" in files and "ignored.py" not in files
    assert not any(f.startswith(("secret/", "node_modules/")) for f in files)
    assert "msg_pb2.py" not in files
    assert read_source(tmp_path, "gen.py", cfg) is None
    assert read_source(tmp_path, "bin.py", cfg) is None
    assert read_source(tmp_path, "keep.py", cfg) is not None

def test_ask_and_stream_ask_cite_locations(index: CodeIndex):
    ans = index.ask("How is the cart total computed with a discount code?", k=5)
    assert isinstance(ans, CodeAnswer) and ans.answer.startswith("Q=")
    assert ans.citations and all(
        ":" in c.location or c.location.endswith(")") or c.location.endswith("/")
        for c in ans.citations
    )
    assert any(c.location.startswith("shop/cart.py:") for c in ans.citations)
    pieces = list(index.stream_ask("where is tax computed?", k=4))
    assert isinstance(pieces[-1], CodeAnswer)
    assert all(isinstance(p, str) for p in pieces[:-1])
    assert pieces[-1].answer == "".join(pieces[:-1])

symbols.text:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("depth", ["symbol", "file"])
def test_update_resummarizes_only_ancestors(tmp_path, depth):
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    shutil.copytree(FIXTURE, repo)
    cache = DiskCache(tmp_path / "cache.sqlite")
    inner = DigestSummarizer()
    summarizer = CachedSummarizationModel(inner, cache)
    idx = build(repo, depth, summarization_model=summarizer)
    assert idx.update() == {"changed_files": [], "reembedded": 0, "resummarized": 0}

    calls_before, misses_before = inner.calls, summarizer.stats.misses
    _edit(
        repo / "shop" / "pricing.py",
        "rates.get(region.lower(), 0.2)",
        "rates.get(region.strip().lower(), 0.2)",
    )
    result = idx.update()
    assert result["changed_files"] == ["shop/pricing.py"]

    leaf = next(h for h in idx.find_symbol("tax_for") if h.kind == "symbol")
    summarized_ancestors = {
        a
        for a in _ancestors(idx.tree, leaf.node_index)
        if "input_hash" in idx.tree.all_nodes[a].metadata
    }
    expected = len(summarized_ancestors) + (1 if depth == "symbol" else 0)
    kinds = {idx.tree.all_nodes[a].metadata["kind"] for a in summarized_ancestors}
    assert {"file", "dir", "repo"} <= kinds
    assert result["resummarized"] == expected
    assert inner.calls - calls_before == expected
    assert summarizer.stats.misses - misses_before == expected
    # Only the edited leaf and the re-summarized summary nodes need new embeddings
    # (symbol summaries live in leaf metadata and are not embedded separately).
    assert result["reembedded"] == 1 + len(summarized_ancestors)
    # Nothing outside the ancestor chain changed.
    others = [
        n
        for n in idx.tree.all_nodes.values()
        if n.metadata.get("path") == "shop/cart.py" and n.metadata["kind"] == "file"
    ]
    assert others and others[0].index not in summarized_ancestors

def test_update_added_and_deleted_files(tmp_path):
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    shutil.copytree(FIXTURE, repo)
    idx = build(repo)
    (repo / "shop" / "shipping.py").write_text(
        '"""Shipping costs."""\n\n\ndef shipping_cost(weight_kg: float, express: bool = False) -> float:\n'
        '    """Cost to ship a parcel of ``weight_kg`` kilograms."""\n'
        "    base = 4.5 + 1.2 * weight_kg\n    return base * 2 if express else base\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (repo / "cli.py").unlink()
    result = idx.update()
    assert result["changed_files"] == ["cli.py", "shop/shipping.py"]
    assert "shop/shipping.py" in idx.files() and "cli.py" not in idx.files()
    assert idx.search("shipping_cost", k=1)[0].path == "shop/shipping.py"
    idx.save(tmp_path / "idx")
    again = CodeIndex.load(
        tmp_path / "idx", embedding_model=HashEmbedder(), summarization_model=EchoSummarizer()
    )
    assert again.update()["changed_files"] == []

def test_cli_index_search_ask_tree_update(tmp_path, fake_default_models):
    from typer.testing import CliRunner

    from raptor.cli import app

    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    shutil.copytree(FIXTURE, repo)
    cfg_path = tmp_path / "code.yaml"
    make_config().to_yaml(cfg_path)
    out = tmp_path / "idx"
    runner = CliRunner()
    r = runner.invoke(
        app,
        [
            "code",
            "index",
            str(repo),
            "--out",
            str(out),
            "-c",
            str(cfg_path),
            "--summary-depth",
            "symbol",
        ],
    )
    assert r.exit_code == 0, r.output
    assert (out / "code.json").exists() and (out / "graph.json").exists()
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["code", "search", str(out), "apply_discount", "-k", "3"])
    assert r.exit_code == 0 and "shop/pricing.py:29-32" in r.output
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["code", "ask", str(out), "How is the total computed?"])
    assert r.exit_code == 0 and "Sources:" in r.output and "shop/cart.py:" in r.output
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["code", "tree", str(out), "--summaries"])
    assert r.exit_code == 0 and "shop/storage/" in r.output and "[concept]" in r.output
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["code", "update", str(out)])
    assert r.exit_code == 0 and "Changed files: 0" in r.output

def test_mcp_tools(index: CodeIndex):
    import anyio

    mcp = pytest.importorskip("mcp")
    from raptor.code.mcp_server import create_server

    server = create_server(index)

    async def run() -> dict:
        import json

        results: dict = {}
        if hasattr(mcp, "Client"):  # mcp >= 2
            client_cm = mcp.Client(server)
        else:  # pragma: no cover - mcp 1.x
            from mcp.shared.memory import create_connected_server_and_client_session

            client_cm = create_connected_server_and_client_session(server._mcp_server)
        async with client_cm as client:
            tools = await client.list_tools()
            results["tools"] = sorted(t.name for t in tools.tools)
            calls = {
                "search_code": {"query": "apply_discount", "k": 3},
                "ask_codebase": {"question": "How is tax computed?"},
                "get_symbol": {"symbol": "Cart.total"},
                "explain_module": {"path": "shop/storage"},
                "get_callers": {"symbol": "apply_discount"},
                "get_callees": {"symbol": "Cart.total"},
            }
            for name, args in calls.items():
                res = await client.call_tool(name, args)
                assert not res.is_error if hasattr(res, "is_error") else not res.isError
                results[name] = json.loads(res.content[0].text)
        return results

    out = anyio.run(run)
    assert out["tools"] == [
        "ask_codebase",
        "explain_module",
        "get_callees",
        "get_callers",
        "get_symbol",
        "search_code",
    ]
    assert out["search_code"]["results"][0]["location"] == "shop/pricing.py:29-32"
    assert out["ask_codebase"]["citations"]
    assert out["get_symbol"]["symbol"]["symbol"] == "Cart.total"
    assert any(c["symbol"] == "apply_discount" for c in out["get_symbol"]["callees"])
    assert out["explain_module"]["module"]["kind"] == "dir"
    assert any(c["symbol"] == "Cart.total" for c in out["get_callers"]["callers"])
    assert any(c["symbol"] == "apply_discount" for c in out["get_callees"]["callees"])

def test_answerer_caches_replies(tmp_path):

    def gen(prompt: str) -> str:
        calls.append(prompt)

def test_mcnemar_and_ci():
    assert mcnemar_exact(0, 0) == 1.0
    assert mcnemar_exact(10, 0) == pytest.approx(2 / 2**10)
    assert mcnemar_exact(5, 5) == 1.0
    lo, hi = bootstrap_ci([True] * 7 + [False] * 3)
    assert lo < 0.7 < hi
    cmp = paired_comparison({"a": True, "b": False, "c": False}, {"a": True, "b": True, "c": False})

def test_rate_limited_key_fails_over_to_next():
    p = pool(2)
    seen = []

    def fn(client):
        seen.append(client)
        if client == "k0":
            raise FakeAPIError(429, "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED")
        return "ok"

    assert p.call("llm:x", None, fn) == "ok"
    assert seen == ["k0", "k1"]
    # k0 is cooling down for this bucket, so the next calls go to k1 ...
    assert p.call("llm:x", None, lambda c: c) == "k1"
    # ... but a different model bucket can still use k0.
    assert p.call("embed:y", None, lambda c: c) == "k0"

def _old_collapsed(tree_dict, query, top_k, max_tokens):
    """The original RAPTOR collapsed-tree algorithm (scipy distances + argsort)."""
    tok = default_tokenizer()
    nodes = [tree_dict[i] for i in sorted(tree_dict)]
    d = [spatial.distance.cosine(query, n.embeddings["OpenAI"]) for n in nodes]
    out, total = [], 0
    for idx in np.argsort(d)[:top_k]:
        t = len(tok.encode(nodes[idx].text))
        if total + t > max_tokens:
            break
        out.append(nodes[idx].index)
        total += t
    return out
